defects.defect: Meta expected a TODAY() field default; the spec considered it first and rejected it for a stated reason (a cleared UI value or an explicit API null saves blank, and the requirement says 'whenever ... blank'). The reason is sound, so this is a design divergence from meta rather than a reuse failure.
The DuplicateRule query failed on a wrong column and was not retried (disclosed). The impact on the design is negligible.
